description: This file defines the 'GrainDirectoryAttribute' class, a custom attribute used to specify the grain directory provider for a grain class in the Orleans framework. It includes constructors, a property for the directory name, and a method to populate related properties.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryAttribute
classes.description: A sealed attribute class that specifies the grain directory provider name for a grain class, implementing IGrainPropertiesProviderAttribute.

methods.name: GrainDirectoryAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that sets the grain directory name to default.

methods.name: GrainDirectoryAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grain directory name with a specified string.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Populates properties dictionary with the grain directory setting based on the attribute's value.
